fieldValues.title: A gate that has never gone red is unproven
fieldValues.summary: A required status check that has only ever been observed passing has not been shown to block anything. Prove it by making it fail on purpose with auto-merge armed, and confirm the pull request stays blocked.
fieldValues.rationale:
The cheaper option was to read the branch protection settings and conclude the gate would work. It loses for the reason the programme exists: this repository has repeatedly found configuration that described an intent nothing enforced — a required context that was not configured as required, a check registry no workflow ran. Settings are a claim; a blocked pull request is evidence.

The cost of the negative test is one throwaway pull request. Pay it every time a gate's behaviour is load-bearing for autonomy, and prove the positive direction too: a green pull request that auto-merges with no human approval.
